as_told.title: Trump told about hybrids in UFO briefing

plain: Donald Trump is said to have been briefed on "legacy programs," meaning long-running secret programmes on UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the newer official word for UFOs. The researcher Matthew Pines says on the show, without naming a source, that he is "pretty confident" Trump knows "at least broad contours that this is real." A congressman named Eric Burlison goes further. Passing on what he was told, he tells Michels the briefing included word that "there are hybrids," meaning beings part human and part not, and that Trump replied, "You mean like Adam Schiff," naming a Democratic congressman. If true, it would mean a president was told such programmes exist.
